name: Cable Row Bar Kneeling Crunch
cardText:
Cable Row Bar Kneeling Crunch
Beginner
1
Use a double handle attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
2
Walk a few steps forward then fall into a kneeling position.
3
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.

name: Cable Standing Crunch
cardText:
Cable Standing Crunch
Intermediate
1
Use a double handle attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
2
Face away from the cable tower and walk a few steps forward.
3
Push your hips back, and flex your abs.
4
Return to the starting standing position and repeat.

name: Cable Kneeling High To Low Wood Chopper
cardText:
Cable Kneeling High To Low Wood Chopper
Intermediate
1
Kneel sideways to cable and grasp handle with both hands overhead.
2
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally down toward opposite hip.
3
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

name: Cable Rope Standing Crunch
cardText:
Cable Rope Standing Crunch
Beginner
1
Stand facing cable, hold rope behind head with elbows tucked in.
2
Brace core and curl torso downward toward hips without pulling with arms.
3
Return slowly to standing tall, keeping constant tension on abs.

name: Cable Standing Low To High Wood Chopper
cardText:
Cable Standing Low To High Wood Chopper
Intermediate
1
Stand sideways to cable and grasp handle near hip level with both hands.
2
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally upward toward opposite shoulder.
3
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.
